office_hours.weekends: Closed on weekends and gazetted holidays
office_hours.administration_block_location: Administration block is located near the main campus entrance.

medical_emergency_clinic.location: Campus Health Clinic, Ground Floor, Medical Wing

attendance_policy.title: Course Attendance Requirement
attendance_policy.rule: Students must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance in each course to be eligible to sit for midterm and final examinations. Attendance below 75% leads to automatic course debarment or withdrawal.

code_of_conduct_and_discipline.title: Student Code of Conduct & Anti-Harassment
code_of_conduct_and_discipline.rule: Zero-tolerance policy towards harassment, cheating, plagiarism, ragging, vandalism, or unauthorized political activity. Any violation will be referred to the University Disciplinary Committee with penalties ranging from fines to suspension or expulsion.

id_card_policy.title: University ID Card Requirement
id_card_policy.rule: Wearing the official university student ID card is mandatory on campus premises and during examinations. Entry without an ID card is strictly restricted at main gates.

library_policy.title: Library Book Borrowing & Returns
library_policy.rule: Undergraduate students can borrow up to 3 books for a duration of 14 days. Overdue items incur a fine of Rs. 200 per day per book. Reference books cannot be issued outside the library.

fee_and_refund_policy.title: Semester Fee Clearance & Refund
fee_and_refund_policy.rule: All tuition dues must be cleared prior to examination slips issuance. Full 100% refund is available within the first week of classes, 50% within the second week, and no refund thereafter.

grading_policy.title: Academic Grading & Minimum CGPA
grading_policy.rule: Minimum passing grade is D (50%). Undergraduate students must maintain a minimum cumulative CGPA of 2.00 to avoid academic warning or probation.

merit_based.concession: Up to 100% tuition fee waiver for top 3 positions
merit_based.documents: Grade transcript, CNIC copy, Application form

need_based.eligibility: Demonstrated financial hardship with minimum CGPA of 2.50
need_based.documents: Parent income certificate, Utility bills, Application form

facilities.central_library: Open Monday to Friday 8:30 AM - 8:00 PM, Saturday 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM
facilities.health_clinic: On-campus basic medical assistance open 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM
facilities.sports_complex: Gymnasium, basketball, badminton, and cricket grounds open 3:00 PM - 8:00 PM
